_comment: Optional per-card overrides. region = [x, y, w, h] of the useful picture inside the source (excludes letterbox bars and burned-in titles). start = video start time in seconds. focus = [x, y] subject point (0-1) when face detection should be overridden. Super-resolution (EDSR stills / FSRCNN video frames) runs before the Lanczos resize when the upscale factor is above 2.5.
